## Checklist

- [ ] User-visible changes have a plain-English entry under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bun run check:payload` and `bun run build` pass
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots in both themes (Ember light and Nebula dark)
- [ ] No new secrets committed, and any new env var is added to `.env.example`
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:` ...)
